question: Who among the following Dance Gurus got Padma Vibhushan in the year 2000?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a renowned Indian classical dancer and guru, credited with the revival of **Odissi dance**.
 
• He was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, in the year **2000**, for his contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra dedicated his life to teaching and performing Odissi, bringing it global recognition as a major classical dance form of India.
 
• He was also a celebrated choreographer, known for blending traditional Odissi with innovative elements, making his performances unique and timeless.
 
• He trained numerous accomplished Odissi dancers, including Sanjukta Panigrahi, who further popularized the dance form both nationally and internationally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight recognized classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is characterized by its fluid movements, intricate footwork, and sculpturesque poses inspired by temple art.
 
• Odissi traditionally narrates stories from Hindu epics like the Mahabharata and Ramayana, often dedicated to Lord Jagannath.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Awards—Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri—are among India’s highest civilian honors, recognizing achievements in various fields.
 
• Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award, given for "exceptional and distinguished service."
 
 
 
• **Notable Contributions of Kelucharan Mohapatra**
 
 
• He reconstructed and revived traditional Odissi dance forms that were on the verge of decline in the mid-20th century.
 
• His choreographic works include iconic pieces like "Dashavatara" and "Pallavi."
 
 
 
• **Other Dance Gurus and Padma Awards**
 
 
• **Birju Maharaj**: Renowned Kathak dancer, recipient of Padma Vibhushan in 1986.
 
• **Bipin Singh**: Key figure in the revival of Manipuri dance, although not awarded the Padma Vibhushan.
